
# Mercedes Garage Dubai — Extended Business Context

> Independent Mercedes-Benz specialist workshop in Al Quoz, Dubai, UAE.

## About Mercedes Garage Dubai

Mercedes Garage Dubai (German Auto Expert) is an independent Mercedes-Benz specialist workshop located in Al Quoz Industrial Area 2, Dubai, UAE. The workshop was founded in 2010 and has since built a reputation as one of Dubai's premier destinations for Mercedes-Benz repair, maintenance, and customization.

What sets Mercedes Garage Dubai apart is its exclusive focus on Mercedes-Benz vehicles. Unlike general automotive workshops that service multiple brands, our team dedicates 100% of its expertise to Mercedes-Benz and AMG vehicles. This specialization allows us to maintain deeper knowledge of Mercedes-specific engineering, diagnostics, and repair procedures.

## Specialized Equipment

- **XENTRY Diagnostic System:** The official Mercedes-Benz diagnostic platform used by authorized dealerships. Allows us to read and clear fault codes, program ECUs, calibrate sensors, and perform advanced electronic diagnostics.
- **Star Diagnosis:** Complementary Mercedes-Benz diagnostic tool for comprehensive vehicle analysis.
- **Paint Booth:** For facelift conversions and custom body work, ensuring OEM-color-matched finishes.
- **Airmatic Diagnostic Equipment:** Specialized tools for diagnosing and repairing Mercedes AIRMATIC air suspension systems.
- **Transmission Flush Systems:** Factory-spec equipment for 7G-Tronic and 9G-Tronic transmission servicing.

## Core Service Categories

### 1. Mercedes Diagnostics & Repair
Comprehensive mechanical and electrical diagnosis using XENTRY. We handle engine fault codes, sensor calibration, ECU programming, and complete mechanical repairs including engine overhauls and transmission servicing.

### 2. Routine Maintenance
Scheduled Service A and Service B intervals, oil changes, filter replacements, fluid top-ups, and multi-point inspections following Mercedes-Benz factory specifications.

### 3. Brake & Suspension Service
OEM brake pad and rotor replacement, brake fluid flushes, ABS diagnostics, Airmatic air suspension repair, strut replacement, and control arm servicing.

### 4. AC Repair & Climate Control
Dubai's extreme summer heat puts stress on Mercedes climate control systems. We offer AC compressor rebuilds, evaporator core replacement, condenser repair, refrigerant recharge, and complete climate control diagnostics.

### 5. AMG Body Kits & Styling
Authentic OEM-spec and high-grade aftermarket AMG body kits. G63 widebody conversions, front splitters, rear diffusers, sport exhaust systems, and complete aerodynamic styling packages.

### 6. Mercedes Facelift Conversions
Generational exterior conversions including W205 to W206 C-Class, W213 E-Class facelifts, G-Wagon conversions, and GLC facelift packages. Includes LED Multibeam headlamps, updated taillights, redesigned bumpers, and complete electronic coding.

### 7. Custom Mercedes Upgrades
Real carbon fiber aerodynamic parts, mirror covers, custom spoiler fitment, interior trim upgrades, ambient lighting expansion, brake caliper painting, and bespoke aesthetic modifications.

## Work Process

1. **Comprehensive Diagnosis:** Every vehicle begins with a full XENTRY diagnostic scan to identify fault codes, sensor issues, and hidden problems.
2. **Transparent Estimate:** We provide a detailed, itemized estimate before any work begins. No hidden charges.
3. **Factory-Spec Repair:** All repairs follow Mercedes-Benz factory specifications using genuine OEM parts and specialized equipment.
4. **Quality-Controlled Road Test:** Every vehicle is road-tested and quality-checked before delivery.

## Trust & Warranty

- 12-month parts and labor warranty on all repairs
- Genuine OEM parts sourced from authorized Mercedes-Benz suppliers
- Certified German car technicians
- Factory-grade XENTRY diagnostic equipment
- 5-star rated by Dubai Mercedes owners
